instruction.text: The first clock shows when Amelia got on a flight to Hong Kong. The second clock shows when she arrived. How long was Amelia on the aeroplane? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when Noah got on a flight to Los Angeles. The second clock shows when he arrived. How long was Noah on the aeroplane? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when Harry got on a flight to New York. The second clock shows when he arrived. How long was Harry on the aeroplane? Fill in the gaps.
Who spent longer on the aeroplane between Amelia, Noah and Harry? Order the lengths of time shown from longest to shortest. Put the longest length of time at the top.
The first clock shows when a football match started. The second clock shows when it finished. How long was the football match? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when a cricket match started. The second shows when it ended. How long was the cricket match? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when Oliver and George started a game of chess. The second shows when they finished. How long was Oliver and George’s game of chess. Fill in the gaps.
Which took longer between the football game, the cricket game and the chess game? Order the lengths of time shown from shortest to longest. Put the shortest length of time at the top.
